steps.name: verify two donations and unseen comment category
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2),name..'['..i..']') end end; assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero()),'second donated book still in inventory'); Runner.twoDonationsLoaded=true; Runner.commentIndex=quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1252); assert(Runner.commentIndex>=2 and Runner.commentIndex<quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1256) and Runner.commentIndex<40); assert(not quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookOwned',Runner.commentIndex)); Runner.lastRequested=quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')

steps.name: grant comment book and finish tutorial before approach
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex); assert(key~=''); if not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()))

steps.name: teacher comments on unaccepted book
steps.until: quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookOwned',Runner.commentIndex) and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()

steps.name: verify retained inventory and unchanged donation state then save
do: assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); assert(quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')==Runner.lastRequested); assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex),quest:GetHero())); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do local expected=(i<2 or (name=='BookOwned' and i==Runner.commentIndex)); assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==expected,name..'['..i..']') end end; for i=0,1 do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero())) end; quest:AutoSave(); Runner.commentVerified=true
